intro_text: Join us in bringing hope, health, and sustainable support to the people of Battambang.

opportunities.title: Calling All Doctors & Healthcare Professionals
opportunities.description: Project Battambang would like to reach out to all healthcare professionals who are keen on finding out more about the project in the interests of volunteering with us in improving healthcare for the people on Koh Dach Island, Cambodia.

opportunities.title: Sponsors & Corporate Partners
opportunities.description: Partner with Project Battambang to fund essential medications, medical equipment, and student scholarships.

opportunities.title: Student Volunteers
opportunities.description: Join our committee or volunteer during annual trips to support health education, triage, and logistics.
